status: EXPLORATORY: every season here was inspected by earlier studies; findings motivate a hypothesis, they are not evidence

definitions.gap: mean confidence of the chosen side minus its hit rate (positive = overconfident)
definitions.bias: mean(y - q) on P(more): positive = the stat lands above the line more often than predicted
definitions.opponent: opponent allowed per-minute rate / league per-minute rate, this season, games strictly before; null before 10 games
